# PUR RED LAB

> Professional profile of Lincă Ovidiu, a Software Developer and Enterprise Architect based in Bucharest, Romania.

Lincă Ovidiu has 18+ years of experience designing scalable systems for fintech, banking and high-traffic digital platforms. His expertise includes enterprise backend architecture, high-scale data and cloud infrastructure, AI-enabled workflows, and modern frontend development.

Core technologies include Laravel (14+ years), WordPress (8+ years), PHP 8, Node.js, Go, TypeScript, React, Vue.js, Kafka, Kubernetes, Docker, AWS, PostgreSQL, MySQL, ClickHouse, LLMs, RAG, Ollama, vLLM, MCP and n8n.

Business contact: contact@pur4u.ro or +40.726.519.320. Availability: available for projects.
